tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything; sticky table headers.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, the header, the tab bar, the confirm sheet.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Hover rows, meter tracks, the PAUSED tag ground, the switch track when off.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card edges, table row rules, dividers. Decorative only; never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, switches and secondary buttons; the neutral LimitMeter fill. At least 3:1 on bg, surface and surface-2 in both themes.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text and figures on bg, surface and surface-2 (13:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Labels, timestamps, units, inactive tabs, stale figures; on bg, surface and surface-2 (5.3:1 or better).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Focus ring, links and the active-tab indicator only. Never a data color. As text, on bg, surface and surface-2 (4.9:1 or better).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill.

tokens.name: pos
tokens.usage: Gains, RUNNING, OPEN market, healthy dots. Always beside a + sign and a ▲. As text on bg, surface, surface-2 and pos-soft (10:1 or better). Differs from neg in lightness by 2.3:1 in both themes, so the pair holds without hue.

tokens.name: pos-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the RUNNING tag, under pos text.

tokens.name: neg
tokens.usage: Losses, HALTED, ERROR, failed dots, Pause all and Flatten. Always beside a − sign and a ▼ when it is a figure. As text on bg, surface, surface-2 and neg-soft (4.6:1 or better).

tokens.name: neg-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the HALTED and ERROR tags, under neg text.

tokens.name: on-neg
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a neg fill (the Flatten button).

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: STALE, WARN events, a LimitMeter past 75%. As text on bg, surface, surface-2 and warn-soft (5.4:1 or better).

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the STALE chip and WARN tags, under warn text.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: LIVE ModeBanner fill only: real money. Loud on purpose, identical in both themes.

tokens.name: on-live
tokens.usage: Text on the live fill (9:1).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: PAPER ModeBanner fill only.

tokens.name: on-paper
tokens.usage: Text on the paper fill (8:1 or better).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the screen behind the ConfirmSheet.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles and the ConfirmSheet title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Stops new orders and cancels 3 open orders.
styles.usage: Sentences: sheet copy, event messages, empty states.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Button labels, field labels, tab labels, table symbols.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Uppercase section and tile labels, table headers. Always muted.

groups.name: Figures
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono for every number, ID and state word, so columns line up.

styles.name: figure-xl
styles.usage: The one hero number per StatTile on Overview.

styles.name: figure-lg
styles.usage: Secondary tile figures, the passcode field.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Table cells, deltas inline, strategy IDs.

styles.name: figure-sm
styles.usage: Timestamps, chips, tags, the ModeBanner, health readouts.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The PITWALL wordmark in the header. Uppercase, nowhere else.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, label-to-figure gap in a tile.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and tags; gap between header items; status dot size.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, row padding, gaps between related rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen gutters, card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections on a screen; sheet top padding.

radius.note: Instrument-tight. Rounded only where a thing is a pill.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, buttons, the top corners of the ConfirmSheet.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Chips, switches, meter tracks, status dots.

shadow.note: Borders, not shadows. Only the ConfirmSheet floats.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: The ConfirmSheet, over the scrim.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px bg gap, then 2px solid accent (8:1 dark, 5.2:1 light on bg).

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of any button, switch hit area or row that acts on tap.

tokens.name: row-h
tokens.usage: DataTable row height.

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: Top header: wordmark, MarketChip, StaleChip, Stop button.

tokens.name: tabbar-h
tokens.usage: Bottom TabBar on phone.

tokens.name: banner-h
tokens.usage: ModeBanner strip above the header.

tokens.name: chip-h
tokens.usage: MarketChip and StaleChip.
